title: Exact finite gap enumeration for quotient index 3003
statement: For odd primes p satisfying 1073741824 < p < 2304192002, exactly five have [F_p^* : <-1,2>] = 3003; they are 1392401011, 1658532877, 1683139459, 2003751751, and 2181655477, and each listed prime has a recorded primitive root g and elements b in gH and c in g^2H satisfying 1+b=c modulo p.
scope: Finite interval only; quotient index exactly 3003; based on the committed Python and C++ artifacts.
limitations: This proposal does not establish the cited historical computation through 2^30.
This proposal does not establish the cited sufficient theorem at or above 2304192002.
The two implementations were produced inside one AI-directed workflow and are not independent reproduction.
Novelty, external review, and results for indices other than 3003 are not established.
